sheets.name: Competitor rubric
sheets.title: Competitor rubric
sheets.guidance: All vendor types assumed to hold AWS, Snowflake and Tableau partnerships. Competitor scores are judgment-based archetypes, not intelligence on named firms.
columns: Niche Consulting lead vs best rival
rows: Penske, 20 subject areas and 32 KPIs on day one
Elite tier, AIM delivery, Frontier Engineering on the team
Three human gates, 3–5 month parallel run, shared RACI
Premier tier; IaC; SOX edition decision with Snowflake
Summit tier; like-for-like layouts; rationalization framework
Niche Consulting-funded AI engineers; accelerators with no license fee
Global bench, peak team of 12, then a 24-month lean run team for continuity
Five-lever TCO and 10-month ROI; validate with ABC Retail actuals in 30 days
$170 / $40 rate card, three scope options, fixed + flex capacity with up to 8% term discount
Name a Niche Consulting executive sponsor and an advisory council
How each rival is likely to attack
Boutique Snowflake firms: depth and focus. Counter with logistics data assets, Tableau and AWS breadth, and scale for parallel tracks.
Tier-1 consultancies: brand, C-suite access, value cases and change management. Counter with right-sized cost, senior hands-on attention and a fixed July 2027 plan.
Mid-sized SIs: price. Counter with reconciliation rigor, Niche Consulting-funded AI capacity and partner funding that narrows the gap.
